entities.name: PMID:27508193
observations: Retrospective cohort of 126 advanced HCC patients receiving sorafenib; >20% AFP decline at 6–8 weeks was associated with median OS 10.9 vs 5.2 months and PFS 5.3 vs 2.9 months; authors reported independent prediction of OS and PFS.

source_tools.relevance: Direct clinical evidence for the question

entities.name: PMID:21885876
observations: Sorafenib-treated advanced HCC exploration cohort (n=41) and validation cohort (n=53), baseline AFP >20 μg/L; >20% AFP decline at 6 weeks predicted PFS in exploration multivariable analysis (HR 0.31, 95% CI 0.13–0.76); OS benefit described as marginal.

source_tools.relevance: Independent cohort evidence on early AFP kinetics and outcomes

entities.name: Early AFP decline in sorafenib HCC
observations: In advanced HCC treated with sorafenib, >20% AFP decline by approximately 6 weeks is associated with longer survival; support includes a retrospective 126-patient cohort reporting independent OS/PFS prediction and a smaller study supporting PFS, while evidence is observational.

source_tools.relevance: Synthesis of direct sorafenib study findings
